title: ConstantPullbackIdentityCoherence
statement:
Let $Z$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $M$ an abelian group, with constant sheaf $M_Z$ [def-constructible-constant]. Let $c:M_Z\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathrm{id}_Z^{-1}M_Z$ be the inverse constant-sheaf comparison, defined by uniqueness of left adjoints to global sections using the inverse-image adjunction [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] and the identification of sections of direct image [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. Let $a:\mathrm{id}_Z^{-1}\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathrm{id}$ be the identity comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition]. Then
$$a_{M_Z}\circ c=\mathrm{id}_{M_Z}.$$
This is an equality of sheaf morphisms, with no cohomology degree or Ext class quantified.

proof.text: Compose constant sheaf adjoint to sections [def-constructible-constant] with identity inverse image adjoint to identity direct image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Transport along the canonical identity comparison for direct image. The section comparison over the terminal object is identity, as follows by evaluating [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] and the identity pullback isomorphism.

The unit equation for a in [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition] identifies this transported adjunction with the original constant-sheaf adjunction. The inverse constant comparison c is the comparison of the same two adjunctions in the other direction. Hence a after c and the identity have the same adjoint, the unit at M. The uniqueness/injectivity assertion of [lem-weil-pbc-conjugate-iso-unit-equation] makes their components equal. This uses no cohomology functor.
